context: Asuka lectures on integrating diverse viewpoints.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: lecture; abstract vocabulary (総合/一体/さまざま/多数/有効) in natural home.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さまざまな意見を、総合して考えます。
lines.en: We integrate various opinions and think.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 多数の意見が、正しいんですか?
lines.style: attentive adult student voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 多数が、常に正しいとは限りません。
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: では、どう総合するんですか?
lines.en: Then how do we integrate them?
lines.style: curious adult student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: さまざまな視点を、一体として見ます。
lines.en: We view various perspectives as one whole.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: それは、有効な方法ですか?
lines.style: thoughtful adult student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、最も有効な考え方の一つです。
lines.en: Yes, one of the most effective ways of thinking.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: さまざまを総合する力、養いたいです。
lines.en: I want to cultivate the power to integrate the various.
lines.style: resolved adult student voice, soft warm realization throughout
